messages:
kevin-logistics: Heads up: AWB 555-8889990 (H100 run) blocked at FRA gate. Broker gateway NACKing manifests intermittently.
skye-forwarder: Confirmed. Partner EDI dropped packets, manifest rejected. Manual broker review adds ~18-26h.
kevin-logistics: Any customs paperwork missing or HS issues?
skye-forwarder: Docs complete. Customs flagged a thermal spot-check on 6 units, asking for depot photos + serials before release.
harper-procurement: If >24h delay, propose air-splitting 6 priority units FRA->LHR. Ballpark uplift?
skye-forwarder: Estimate ~€60k for 6 units OTD next-day including brokerage. Need go-ahead by COB.
nico-ops: Those 6 are earmarked for a Dedicated pool rollout. Sam, impact if delayed 24-48h?
sam-sre: Losing 6 will increase queue latency ~20% for that pool and delay a customer install. Canary scaling mitigates ~60% of impact; still risky for SLA.
kevin-logistics: Important: RMA continuity if split AWBs. We had duplicate RMAs before.
skye-forwarder: Warranty follows serials. We'll attach single RMA to any split AWBs. Depot photos + signed manifest trigger claim.
rma-bot: RMA created: RMA-9911 linked to AWB 555-8889990. Status: awaiting depot photos.
kevin-logistics: Uploading serials now: [H100-ZZ1001,H100-ZZ1002,H100-ZZ1003,H100-ZZ1004,H100-ZZ1005,H100-ZZ1006]
harper-procurement: I'll route €60k uplift to finance. If finance declines, fallback to hold + Sam's canary plan.
kevin-logistics: Skyean you escalate surcharge waiver if EDI outage owned by your partner? We prefer not to absorb uplift if outage caused delay.
skye-forwarder: Escalated. Partner accepted fault and opened surcharge dispute. Will update in ~3h. Prioritizing depot photos for RMA.
